narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I say a positive take away a negative must be negative, because of the minus sign.
<bookmark mark='test'/>Test it on a balance of ten rupees. Take away a debit of three rupees.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The debit is cancelled, so the balance rises to thirteen rupees. That is positive, not negative.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check a pairing, try a bigger credit first and then a bigger debit.
<bookmark mark='sign'/>If the sign changes between the two tries, that pairing can go either way.
